Luminex assay.readouts: cytokine/chemokine concentration levels including IP-10, MCP-1, MIP-1β, IL-2, IL-6, IL-12 p70, IL-10, IL-1RA, IFN-γ, IFN-α, TNF-α, TNF-β

evidence_location.quote: The vaccine rVSV-ZEBOV induced a rapid and robust increase in cytokine levels, with a maximum peak as early as day 1. Significant increases in concentration levels were noted for IP-10 (CXCL-10) on days 1 and 3 and for MCP-1 and MIP-1β on day 1 relative to their expression on day 0.

flow cytometry.readouts: frequencies of innate immune cell subsets and mean fluorescence intensity of activation/surface markers on mDCs, pDCs, monocytes, and NK cells

evidence_location.quote: Significant modulations were seen in the frequency of CD86+/CD40+ mDCs and pDCs as well as CD16+ inflammatory monocytes, accompanied by an increase in the mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) of CD40 on pDCs and CD86 on mDCs.

ELISA.readouts: EBOV-GP-binding antibody levels against Kikwit GP or Gueckedou GP/inactivated whole virions; optical density or log ELISA units/mL

evidence_location.quote: On day 28 after vaccination, the rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine induced glycoprotein-specific antibodies in all participants at all doses, demonstrating its robust immunogenicity.

Next-Generation RNA Sequencing.readouts: gene expression levels, differentially expressed genes, fold changes

evidence_location.quote: The highest number of differentially expressed genes was observed on day 1 after vaccination, with 10,123 genes being significantly differentially expressed compared with day 0.
